concepts.title: Statistical Questions
concepts.definition: A question that can be answered by gathering data where the responses are expected to vary rather than being a single, constant value.
concepts.key_idea: Anticipates variability in the collected data rather than a single deterministic answer.

solution_steps.action: Analyze the nature of the question
solution_steps.explain: Check if answering the question requires collecting data that varies across different subjects or times.
If the responses can differ (e.g., heights of students, daily temperatures), it is a statistical question. If it has a single fixed answer, it is not.

concepts.title: Arithmetic Mean
concepts.definition: The representative value of a dataset calculated by dividing the sum of all the values by the total count of those values.
concepts.key_idea: Represents the equal-share or fair-share value of a dataset.

solution_steps.action: Divide the sum by the count of values
solution_steps.explain: Divide the total sum by the number of observations to find the mean.

concepts.title: Median of Odd-Sized Dataset
concepts.definition: The middle value of an ordered dataset containing an odd number of elements, dividing the data into two equal halves.
concepts.key_idea: The exact center value of sorted data when the count is odd.

concepts.title: Median of Even-Sized Dataset
concepts.definition: The average of the two middlemost values in an ordered dataset containing an even number of elements.
concepts.key_idea: The average of the two central values when the dataset cannot be split by a single middle element.

concepts.title: Range of a Dataset
concepts.definition: The difference between the maximum and minimum values in a dataset, which measures the spread or variability of the data.
concepts.key_idea: Measures the total spread between the extreme values of a dataset.

concepts.title: Outliers
concepts.definition: Values in a dataset that deviate significantly from the rest of the observations, which can heavily skew the mean but have little effect on the median.
concepts.key_idea: Extreme values that distort the mean but leave the median relatively unaffected.

concepts.key_idea: Enables direct visual comparison between two related groups of data across categories.

concepts.definition: A simple chart consisting of data points plotted as dots on a number line, showing the frequency and distribution of values.
concepts.key_idea: Visualizes the frequency, clusters, and gaps in small datasets.

questions: Shreyas counts the number of times he can bounce the ball on the bat: 6, 2, 9, 5, 4, 6, 3, 5. Calculate the average number of bounces.
Two friends are training to run a 100 m race. Nikhil: 17, 18, 17, 16, 19, 17, 18; Sunil: 20, 18, 18, 17, 16, 16, 17. Who on average ran quicker?
The enrolment in a school during six consecutive years was as follows: 1555, 1670, 1750, 2013, 2040, 2126. Find the mean enrolment in the school during this period.
Find the median of onion prices in Yahapur and Wahapur.
Sanskruti asked her class how many domestic animals and pets each had at home: 0, 1, 0, 4, 8, 0, 0, 2, 1, 1, 5, 3, 4, 0, 0, —, 10, 25, 2, —, 2, 4. Find the mean and median.

The daily water usage from a tap was measured: 5.6, 8, 3.09, 12.9, 6.5, 12.1, 11.3, 20.5, 7.4. Can the mean or median daily usage lie between 25 and 30? Can the mean or median be lesser than the minimum value or greater than the maximum value in a data?
Preyashi asked her students if they would choose to become aquatic, aerial, or spaceborne. Draw a double-bar graph comparing Grade 5 and Grade 9 choices.
The temperature variation over two days in different months in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, is given. Draw a double-bar graph using the scale 1 unit = 4°C.

The points scored by each player in four games are given: Player A (14, 16, 10, 10), Player B (0, 8, 6, 4), Player C (8, 11, Did not play, 13). Find the average number of points scored per game by A. To find the mean number of points scored per game by C, would you divide the total points by 3 or by 4? Why? Who is the best performer?

The marks (out of 100) obtained by a group of students in a GK quiz are 85, 76, 90, 85, 39, 48, 56, 95, 81 and 75. Another group's scores are 68, 59, 73, 86, 47, 79, 90, 93 and 86. Compare and describe both groups' performance using mean and median.

There are two 7th grade sections at a school. Each section has 15 boys and 15 girls. In one section, the mean height of students is 154.2 cm. What must be true about the mean height of students in the other section?
